name: Enterprise Position, Role and Accountability
constraints: A position is a durable vacant-capable seat and survives occupant change.
Vacancy derives from authorized capacity and effective occupancy.
Occupancy termination never deletes the position, authorized FTE or seat budget.
Role types declare scheme, version and semantic axis.
PartyRole is an addressable time-bounded assertion linking player or position to a host.
PartyRole, accountability and decision-right assertions grant no IAM permission.
RACI pins host, role, player or position, validity and conflict policy.
One Accountable and at least one Responsible apply per host and interval unless a named profile states otherwise.
Segregation conflicts require explicit time-limited exceptions.
Fractional occupancies may share a pooled position only within authorized capacity.
